bundle.shortDescription: Local-first AI operations cockpit for AI-assisted development.
bundle.longDescription: RepoDesk is a local-first desktop cockpit for AI-assisted development: connect a project, scope a task, build bounded context, run safety/budget checks, route work to the right (preferably local) model, and know when it is safe to commit.
